required_before_lock: fill lux meter application name and version
replace APK sha256 with instrumented ARM64 APK hash
confirm proposed fixed fixtures or edit them
regenerate final_artifact_lock and implementation_snapshot after instrumentation patch

validity_policy.VALID_PASS: procedure valid and output matches expected result
validity_policy.VALID_FAIL: procedure valid but application result fails expected behavior; retain as research data
validity_policy.INVALID: execution violates protocol; exclude from performance denominator and repeat with new ID
validity_policy.RETEST: new execution linked to original test_id; never overwrite original record
